title: Diodorus Siculus, Bibliotheca historica, Books XXI–XL (fragments); «Историческая библиотека», кн. XXI–XL
author: Diodorus Siculus
edition: Dindorf, Teubner 1867–68 (public domain). Goukowsky, CUF (in copyright, partial)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia: a full but amateur Russian translation (simposium.ru, 2012, «непрофессиональный») and Alekseev 1774–75 (from French). Professional Russian only as excerpts (ancientrome: 26, 34–39)
en_evidence: Loeb (Walton). attalus.org covers books 33–40 (links on ru.wikipedia)
other_translations: French: 19th-century complete translation (remacle.org) and the CUF series
value: The main continuous source for the First Punic War, the Sicilian slave wars, the Hellenistic kingdoms, the Gracchi and the Social War. Widely used by students; a critical Russian translation is still lacking.
ai_feasibility: High: standard Hellenistic Greek. The excerpt source of each fragment must be labelled
